item.title: Be the source: getting AEC data ready for AI search
item.description:
Sarah runs marketing at a structural engineering firm in Portland. Her firm ranks on page one, yet when she asked ChatGPT which local firms have real mass-timber experience, it named five others. Martin takes her situation apart: why page one is no longer the finish line, how project galleries and PDFs hide the facts engineers search for, what localizing a timber page for U.S. and Canadian design codes taught him, and how a fact travels the “load path” into an AI answer.

Chapters:

  • 0:00 Cold open: Sarah's story
  • 1:06 "But our SEO works"
  • 2:36 The gallery problem
  • 4:09 The timber page
  • 5:48 The Vancouver twist
  • 7:09 Load path, part one
  • 8:20 The PDF argument
  • 9:43 Load path, part two
  • 11:21 What do I tell my boss?
  • 12:34 Close

Read the article: Be the source: getting AEC data ready for AI search

Martin's voice is an AI clone of his own voice; Sarah is a fictional co-host voiced by AI. Produced with ElevenLabs.
